title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + enhanced audit logging
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 (configurable enforcement modes) and improve audit logging for KMS operations. Includes migration tool to detect/annotate resources that violate residency constraints. No breaking API changes; rollout gated behind feature flag.
description:
Context: customers in EU/UK regulated environments require that KMS keys and encrypted payloads remain in specific regions. RBAC v1 allowed annotations but lacked a first-class enforcement mode and produced limited audit events. This PR extends RBAC v2 to support configurable KMS region pinning (modes: disabled|audit|enforce) and enriches audit logs with KMS key metadata and decision reasons.

What this PR does: - Adds a KMS residency policy field to RBAC v2 policy schema and enforcer (internal/rbac/v2). - Implements enforcement modes: 'audit' (record violations), 'enforce' (deny requests where key.region != resource.region), 'disabled' (no checks). - Enhances audit events with kms.key_id, kms.region, policy.id, decision=(allowed|denied|audit_violation), and policy_reason. - Adds a migration command (cmd/migrate/residency_migration.go) to scan resources and emit a report or optionally annotate resources that are missing residency metadata. - Adds integration tests and CI harness updates to exercise cross-region KMS scenarios and fallback logic. - Adds documentation and operator guidance (docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md) including rolling upgrade instructions and best practices for large fleets.

Checklist: - [x] Design review (SEC/ENG) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests (inc. simulated cross-region KMS) - [x] Migration tool + dry-run mode - [x] Docs and runbook - [x] Telemetry and metrics for violations

Rollout plan: feature gated behind config 'rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning_mode' (default: audit). We will deploy as audit-only for 2 weeks across canary clusters, monitor violation rate and false positives, then flip to enforce incrementally by region. The migration tool can be run in dry-run to produce an initial report for customers.

Related: ENG-1543 (policy enforcement), SEC-981 (audit schema), SUP-4021 (customer support case requesting KMS region enforcement).

notes: Migration note: customers should run cmd/migrate/residency_migration --dry-run to get a CSV report of resources that will be impacted before flipping enforcement to 'enforce'.
Configuration: rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning_mode can be set per-cluster or per-organization. Operators should start with 'audit' and monitor 'rbac.kms_violation_count'.
Telemetry: new metric 'rbac.kms_violation_count' and audit event type 'rbac.kms_policy_decision' were added.
Backcompat: When mode=disabled we preserve current behavior; mode=audit only emits events; mode=enforce denies requests.
